page.content:
Starfleet's most storied name — NCC-1701 and her heirs.

How USS Enterprise connects

  • Faction: Starfleet — The Enterprise is a Starfleet ship.
  • Faction: Enterprise crew — Kirk's crew lives aboard the Enterprise.
  • Faction: Enterprise-D crew — Picard's crew serves aboard later Enterprises.

What is USS Enterprise?

The USS Enterprise is the ship-name that carries Kirk's TOS vessel and later Picard's Enterprise-D and -E as the franchise's moving hometown.

Key threads lead to Starfleet, Enterprise crew and Enterprise-D crew.
